title: A Treatise on Skirmish Fire
summary: Teaches riflemen to fight in open order, spacing, dropping and sprinting between cover while keeping a steady rate of fire.

title: Handbook of Qi-Loaded Shot
summary: Shows how to load and prime a rifle with qi in the hands so charge, ball and lock work as one.

title: Lessons in the Fixed Blade
summary: Teaches the rifleman to meet a close rush with the bayonet, the barrel and the butt, backed by qi.

title: Rifleman's Canon of Cover and Advance
summary: Sets out how a rifleman uses walls, ditches and rubble for fire and moves forward between them under pressure.

title: The Long-Range Marksman's Course
summary: Trains judging of distance, hold-over and qi-narrowed aim for the rifleman who fires at the far limit of the weapon.

title: Notes on Fire from Rubble and Rail
summary: Records the ways a rifleman rests the barrel on ledges, rails and sandbags and slips away when the position is lost.

title: Guide to the Fouled Barrel
summary: Explains how to keep a rifle firing when fouling, a hangfire or a jammed ball threatens to stop it.

title: Rifle and Step: A Treatise on Movement Under Fire
summary: Teaches a rifleman to fire while advancing, retreating and dodging, using qi to start and stop quickly.

title: Workbook of the Quick Reload
summary: Breaks the loading of a rifle into short drilled motions and speeds them with qi, even while retreating.
